reply.answer_text: If the claims system is down, the back office switches to a manual paper workaround. Claims can still be assessed and authorised on paper with dual sign-off (two signatories required). A system outage is not a defence for delaying payment — we remain accountable to pay claims in full. The delay depends on whether it's flagged as a SEV1 (highest severity) or within our tolerance threshold.
